conditions: Use only a reseller agreement/partner authorization: Terms §4 prohibit resale of raw capacity without a reseller agreement; the Partner page expressly describes own-brand downstream resale and a program enrollment process.

Reconcile Terms §3 credit non-transferability between organizations with the Partner page's per-customer workspaces, management API, and bonus-credit wallet before any downstream balances/keys are used.

Partner page advertises a ₹50,000 minimum prepaid reseller commitment and 15% bonus credits at the stated level; record the actual authorized commitment, agreement and quote before any price decision. No commitment or plan is accepted by this proposal.

Identify exact model IDs, model cards/license, and all open-weight model restrictions. IndieRouter claims to serve models on its own Indian GPUs, but model publisher, license and actual running model are distinct facts.
Record current account/route availability, service limits and any contractual SLA. Shared-plan SLOs are targets; only Enterprise/Sovereign contractual SLA terms provide service credits.
Record deployment/data/trust conditions and Vrooli's customer price as separate human decisions; public partner margin or model rates are not approvals.

This is only a conditional candidate; the specific agreement must resolve that interaction and exact customer funding model.
